description: Mark an item on the signed-in member's Checklist as done (from list_checklist_items), reopen one, or set its due date. Use it when the member says 'I've done that' or 'move that to the 15th'. A date set here is the member's own and the feed will not move it. This writes to their real record: name the item first. Returns the item as stored.

done.description: true marks it done (default), false reopens it.

due_date.description: A new due date, YYYY-MM-DD, or null to clear it.

name: complete_checklist_item
title: Complete a checklist item
